briefdescription.para: Apply assumption-aware simplifications to an integrand.

detaileddescription.para: When the AssumptionContext indicates the integration variable is Positive, replaces |var| with var throughout the integrand. Returns the original expression unchanged if no simplifications apply.

briefdescription.para: Recursively replace |var| with var in an AST when the variable is known Positive.

detaileddescription.para: Traverses the expression tree and replaces any FunctionNode(Abs, [arg]) where arg is exactly the integration variable with just the variable itself. This is valid when the AssumptionContext confirms the variable is Positive.
